name: block-feature-grid
title: Feature grid block
description: A section title above a responsive grid of short features.
a11y: A section named by its title; features are a list of items.
Feature titles are headings one level below the section title, so the outline stays in order.

props.name: title
props.description: Section heading shown above the grid.

props.name: description
props.description: Optional muted line under the section heading.

props.name: features
props.description: The items to show, each with a `title`, `description` and optional `icon`.

props.name: columns
props.description: Number of columns on wide screens: 2, 3 (default) or 4. Fewer columns are used on narrow screens.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: Outline level of the section title; each feature title is one level lower.
